selection: Reveal one at the beginning of each Era. Score current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: Intelligence Enters the Price
mandates.rulesText: Most Customers; at least 1 Customer required. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: Successor Accounts Recognized
mandates.rulesText: Most Customers; at least 1 Customer required. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: The Campus Becomes a Climate
mandates.rulesText: Most currently connected Facilities; at least 1 required. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: The Grid Borrows Tomorrow
mandates.rulesText: Most currently connected Facilities plus operating Mega-Clusters; at least 2 combined required. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: Supported Meaning Becomes Law
mandates.rulesText: Most currently active Joint Ventures; at least 1 required. Count each agreement for each partner, regardless of creation Era. Fixed hosts must still exist, belong to their partners, remain adjacent, and be connected. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: Refusal Remains Legible
mandates.rulesText: Most Trust among institutions with at least 1 Customer. Zero Trust can qualify. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: The Jurisdiction Becomes a Platform
mandates.rulesText: Most different controlled non-Frontier hex categories; at least 1 required. Frontier never counts; tied presence does not control a hex. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: The Public Result Holds
mandates.rulesText: Most Capability among institutions with at least 2 Trust and at least 1 Capability. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: ${terms.resources.compute} Becomes Public Weather
mandates.rulesText: Highest current nominal Compute production capacity from connected Facilities, operating Mega-Clusters, and active Joint Ventures; at least 1 required. Ignore resource caps. Do not run Production or faction abilities again. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: Maintained Reality Is Certified
mandates.rulesText: Fewest current Scrutiny among institutions with at least 3 Customers. Zero Scrutiny can win. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: Contestability Standard Maintained
mandates.rulesText: Most Capability among institutions with at least 4 Trust and at least 1 Capability. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

mandates.name: Capital Finds the Default
mandates.rulesText: Most current Runway among institutions owning at least 1 Facility. Zero Runway can qualify. Score 2 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}; tied leaders each score 1. Read current public state after Audit.

tieRule: Tied leaders each score 1 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate} unless the card says otherwise.
